blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: 32x32 register file with asynchronous reset, x0 hardwired to zero, asynchronous reads, and synchronous write on rising clock when write_en is asserted.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates the only architectural register state, simplifies x0 and reset handling, and makes register write behavior independently verifiable.

blocks.name: immediate_gen
blocks.responsibility: Generate sign-extended I, S, B, U, and J immediates from the 32-bit instruction word according to the RV32I field mapping.
blocks.design_rationale: A dedicated combinational immediate generator avoids duplicated bit manipulations, reduces top-level wiring, and makes ISA immediate mapping directly auditable.

blocks.name: control_decoder
blocks.responsibility: Decode RV32I opcode, funct3, and funct7 into control signals for ALU operation, immediate selection, register write, memory access, branch evaluation, and jump handling.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizes ISA semantics in one small combinational block, reducing top-level complexity and improving verifiability of instruction behavior.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Compute 32-bit arithmetic, logical, shift, comparison, and pass-through results used by ALU instructions, address generation, target generation, and LUI.
blocks.design_rationale: A single shared datapath minimizes area and keeps the critical path short; a fixed operation encoding simplifies verification.

blocks.name: branch_unit
blocks.responsibility: Evaluate branch conditions for BEQ, BNE, BLT, BGE, BLTU, and BGEU using rs1, rs2, branch_type, and branch_en.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates signed and unsigned branch comparisons from the ALU, avoids unnecessary ALU side effects, and makes branch semantics easy to test.

blocks.name: load_extend
blocks.responsibility: Select byte, halfword, or word data from the asynchronous 32-bit memory read word and apply sign or zero extension according to funct3 and address low bits.
blocks.design_rationale: Separates little-endian byte/half selection and load extension rules into a small combinational block, improving clarity and verification of load instructions.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Top-level single-cycle RV32I CPU: owns the PC register, instantiates the generated blocks, muxes operands and writeback data, computes next PC priority, and drives the required external bus contract.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps the externally visible entity stable and minimal while delegating ISA-specific logic to independently testable blocks, reducing top-level area and verification risk.

notes: All generated blocks except register_file and cpu are purely combinational. The cpu block owns the PC register and implements next-PC priority: JAL/JALR, taken branch, pc+4. During asynchronous reset, cpu forces PC and memory-write outputs to safe values. Suggested encodings: imm_sel 000=I, 001=S, 010=B, 011=U, 100=J; alu_op 0000=ADD, 0001=SUB, 0010=SLL, 0011=SLT, 0100=SLTU, 0101=XOR, 0110=SRL, 0111=SRA, 1000=OR, 1001=AND, 1010=PASS_B; branch_type 000=BEQ, 001=BNE, 010=BLT, 011=BGE, 100=BLTU, 101=BGEU.

instructions.description: U-type: rd = instr[31:12] << 12.
U-type: rd = pc + (instr[31:12] << 12).
J-type: rd = pc + 4; pc = pc + sign-extended J immediate.
I-type: rd = pc + 4; pc = (rs1 + sign-extended I immediate) & 0xFFFFFFFE.
B-type: if rs1 == rs2 then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
B-type: if rs1 != rs2 then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
B-type: if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
B-type: if signed(rs1) >= signed(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
B-type: if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
B-type: if unsigned(rs1) >= unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4.
Load byte: read 8 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and sign-extend to 32 bits into rd.
Load halfword: read 16 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and sign-extend to 32 bits into rd.
Load word: read 32 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate into rd.
Load byte unsigned: read 8 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and zero-extend to 32 bits into rd.
Load halfword unsigned: read 16 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and zero-extend to 32 bits into rd.
Store byte: write rs2[7:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate.
Store halfword: write rs2[15:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate.
Store word: write rs2[31:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate.
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 + sign-extended I immediate.
OP-IMM: rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(I immediate) else 0.
OP-IMM: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(I immediate) else 0.
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 XOR sign-extended I immediate.
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 OR sign-extended I immediate.
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 AND sign-extended I immediate.
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 logical left shift by instr[24:20].
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 logical right shift by instr[24:20].
OP-IMM: rd = rs1 arithmetic right shift by instr[24:20].
OP: rd = rs1 + rs2.
OP: rd = rs1 - rs2.
OP: rd = rs1 logical left shift by rs2[4:0].
OP: rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) else 0.
OP: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) else 0.
OP: rd = rs1 XOR rs2.
OP: rd = rs1 logical right shift by rs2[4:0].
OP: rd = rs1 arithmetic right shift by rs2[4:0].
OP: rd = rs1 OR rs2.
OP: rd = rs1 AND rs2.
